scripts.lint: pnpm -r run lint && vp lint --config .oxlintrc.json --type-aware --fix tools test vite.config.ts
scripts.check:architecture: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.jsonc --output-type err-long tools app/*/api com/*/api org/*/api
scripts.test: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=4 run test && pnpm run test:repo
scripts.test:repo: EDGE_TRACKED_FILES="$(git ls-files)" vp test run --dir test
scripts.test:stress: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=4 run test:stress && pnpm run test:repo:stress
scripts.test:repo:stress: EDGE_TRACKED_FILES="$(git ls-files)" vp test run --dir test --sequence.shuffle
scripts.check: pnpm run check:static && pnpm run test
scripts.check:static: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint:check && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip && pnpm run check:workers && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run check:deps && pnpm run check:spelling
scripts.lint:check: pnpm -r run lint:check && vp lint --config .oxlintrc.json --type-aware tools test vite.config.ts
